debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d a b-i-d-c-o-n-s-o-r-t-i-u-m o-u-t-l-i-n-e f-o-r t-h-r-e-e a-l-l-i-e-d f-i-r-m-s a-n-d l-e-f-t a w-o-r-d-f-i-l-e on the s-h-a-r-e-d d-r-i-v-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) the a-c-t-o-r s-e-t-u-p h-i-d-d-e-n s-u-b-s-i-d-y p-a-t-h-s b-e-t-w-e-e-n the b-i-d-d-e-r-s f-o-r c-o-v-e-r p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s a-n-d l-e-f-t t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r l-e-d-g-e-r-s i-n u-n-l-a-b-e-l-e-d e-x-c-e-l w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the b-e-n-e-f-i-c-i-a-r-y d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-h-e-c-k.
3) the a-c-t-o-r e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d c-o-s-t e-s-t-i-m-a-t-e-s a-m-o-n-g the c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r-s t-o a-l-i-g-n p-r-i-c-i-n-g a-n-d l-e-f-t m-e-t-i-n-g n-o-t-e-s i-n a j-o-i-n-t s-h-a-r-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-r-i-c-e-s-o-l-i-t-a-t-i-o-n f-i-r-e-w-a-l-l a-u-d-i-t.
4) the a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e d-e-f-i-n-i-n-g w-h-i-c-h f-i-r-m w-i-n-s e-a-c-h r-o-u-n-d a-n-d l-e-f-t a c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r f-i-l-e i-n a p-r-i-v-a-t-e f-o-l-d-e-r w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t o-f i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t d-e-c-l-a-r-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the a-c-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d a p-a-c-k-a-g-e d-e-s-i-g-n-e-d t-o m-i-m-i-c c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e b-i-d-d-i-n-g a-n-d l-e-f-t a t-e-n-d-e-r f-i-l-e l-i-s-t i-n the p-u-b-l-i-c p-o-r-t-a-l w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-n-t-i-c-o-l-l-u-s-i-o-n c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
